stem: Students study a landform that is found at the mouth of a river.
instruction: Which statement BEST explains the processes that cause this landform?

options.label: A
options.text: As ocean waves break on the shore, they deposit sediment from the ocean to the mouth of the river.

options.label: B
options.text: As the river water flows into the ocean, it slows down, causing sediments to be deposited at the mouth of the river.

options.label: C
options.text: As the river water flows into the ocean, it speeds up, causing sediments to be deposited at the mouth of the river.

options.label: D
options.text: As ocean waves break on the shore, they deposit sediment from the shoreline to the mouth of the river.

visual_elements: Diagram of a river flowing from land into the ocean with a labeled landform at the river mouth.
